Flow: Control / shut down the Fan in the Inductive Automation Water Treatment Demo.

Key grounding: this is a 2-click flow. Clicking the Fan control only opens a popup. The actual action is always one of the popup options.

1) Find and click the Fan control (visible label: Fan). Clicking it opens an overlay/popup next to the control.
2) INSIDE the popup, you will see exactly these 4 option labels: Run, Stop, Off, Auto. These are the only valid next actions.
   - To shut down / turn off the fan: click Off
   - To pause / stop the fan: click Stop
   - To start the fan: click Run
   - To return to automatic control: click Auto

Popup targeting rules (strict):
- After clicking Fan, the very next step must be clicking one of the popup labels (Run/Stop/Off/Auto). Do not treat clicking Fan as the final step.
- When the popup is open, only consider targets inside the popup. Ignore any background text/buttons with the same words.
- Always return an actionLabel that matches the exact visible popup label (case-sensitive as shown). If an actionId exists in overlayActions/uiActions for that popup option, return it.

Success signal:
- After clicking the popup option, the fan state changes and/or the fan SVG/icon changes. Treat the visual state change as success.

Flow: Change mode via the Mode control. Expected UI: clicking 'Mode' opens a popup with OFF/AUTO/STOP/RUN options. Prefer clicking those exact labels when present. Success often shows as an icon/SVG state change (filled vs outline) and/or a label update near the mode selector. If a popup is open, targets inside it take priority over background elements with the same labels.
